title: Easy French Onion Chicken and Rice Casserole
ingredients: 2 cups cooked white rice (jasmine rice recommended)
1 can Campbell's Cream of Chicken with Herbs Soup
A couple shakes of Worcestershire sauce
A few additional shakes of Worcestershire sauce
Cooking spray or butter, for greasing the casserole dish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x9-inch casserole dish.

In a large bowl, combine shredded rotisserie chicken, cooked white rice, cream of chicken with herbs soup, sour cream, mayonnaise, Lipton Onion Soup Mix, a couple shakes of Worcestershire sauce, and shredded mozzarella cheese. Mix until fully combined and creamy.
Transfer the mixture to the greased casserole dish and spread into an even layer, pressing into the corners.
Arrange the 5 slices of provolone cheese evenly over the top (cut one slice in half to fit if needed).
Lightly crush the crispy fried onions (don't crush into crumbs — keep some crunch), then mix with melted butter and a few shakes of Worcestershire sauce until evenly coated.
Sprinkle the buttery crispy onion mixture evenly over the provolone cheese.
Bake uncovered on the middle or lower-middle rack at 350°F for 30 minutes, until hot, bubbly, and golden on top.
Let cool a few minutes before serving so the filling can set.
notes: Use fully cooked rice — do not add uncooked rice. Any cooked white rice works. Leftover cooked chicken can substitute for rotisserie chicken. Can prep the chicken/rice mixture ahead and refrigerate; add the provolone and crispy onion topping just before baking for best crunch. Leftovers keep refrigerated 3-4 days; reheat individual portions in the microwave. Approx. 629 calories per serving.
